description: Build, run, monitor, and troubleshoot data pipelines with Supaflow.

interface.longDescription:
Build and run data pipelines directly in ChatGPT. Move data across SaaS apps, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes. Transform data using dbt Core™ models and sync data to your business apps with reverse ETL. Orchestrate pipelines, manage schedules, and troubleshoot issues—all through conversation.

Getting started: create a Supaflow account or sign in, install the plugin, and authorize Supaflow. Ask for help getting started to verify your workspace and available connections. Configure source and destination credentials securely in Supaflow before creating or running a pipeline; never paste credentials into chat. Setup guide: https://www.supa-flow.io/agentic-data-pipelines/chatgpt-plugin
defaultPrompt: Plan a Salesforce-to-Snowflake pipeline for Accounts and Opportunities, then ask me before creating it
Show me which pipelines failed in the last 24 hours, explain why, and recommend the next action
Run my HubSpot-to-Snowflake pipeline, monitor the job to completion, and summarize the outcome

publication.release_notes: Clarifies sequential pipeline-schema pagination through sparse and empty pages. Prevents skipped-offset and binary-search probes, preserves fixed traversal scope and page size, and avoids unnecessary field detail for object-name inspection. Keeps the existing onboarding, listing, production MCP connection, and OAuth configuration.
